sentences.en: I had to get the axes to chop the wood.
We still have to turn the hay and chop wood.
sentences.zh: 我们还得把干草翻一翻，再砍些木头。

sentences.en: Let me show you how to chop onions without crying.
sentences.zh: 让我来教你如何切洋葱而不流泪。
